policy.name: catherine-kpn.15 architecture policy
policy.purpose: The complete set of permitted crate dependency edges in the catherine workspace, stated as referential-agreement claims. The paired actual edges (Dep) must agree with the allowed edges (AllowedEdge) via the inject coproduct equations; any crate dependency outside this set is unpaired, and any edge whose direction differs fails the equations.
policy.scope_note: Authored from the design documents, not mirrored from Cargo.toml: the policy may match today's tree only by agreement, never by construction.

edge_citations.ae_core_engine: The engine is the dependency-light interned execution core split out of the kernel; the kernel wraps it verbatim and downstream paths depend on it through core. docs/kani-lane.md: 'the engine moved out of the kernel into crates/catherine-engine ... catherine-core wraps both modules verbatim (pub use catherine_engine::{engine, model})'.
edge_citations.ae_analysis_core: Dependency direction: analysis -> core. docs/DESIGN.md:156-158: 'Dependency direction: cli/wasm -> inquiry -> analysis -> core'. README.md:205: 'kernel stays suite-dep-free'.
edge_citations.ae_cli_core: docs/DESIGN.md:156-158: 'Dependency direction: cli/wasm -> inquiry -> analysis -> core'; cli reaches the kernel. README.md:205: CLI plumbing via genesis-vibes 'CLI crate only; kernel stays suite-dep-free'.
edge_citations.ae_cli_analysis: docs/DESIGN.md:156-158: 'cli/wasm -> inquiry -> analysis -> core'; the headless CLI runner uses 'same core' per the crate map in docs/DESIGN.md:150-155.
edge_citations.ae_cli_genesis_vibes: docs/DESIGN.md:156-158: 'catherine-cli additionally consumes genesis-vibes (envelope/guide only — never leaks into the kernel)'. README.md:205: 'genesis-vibes (CLI crate only; kernel stays suite-dep-free)'.
edge_citations.ae_wasm_core: docs/DESIGN.md:156-158: 'Dependency direction: cli/wasm -> inquiry -> analysis -> core'; wasm reaches the kernel, genesis-free per docs/DESIGN.md:132.
edge_citations.ae_wasm_analysis: docs/DESIGN.md:156-158: 'cli/wasm -> inquiry -> analysis -> core'; wasm bindings are 'no logic of its own' over analysis, genesis-free (docs/DESIGN.md:132).
edge_citations.ae_ledger_core: The decision ledger records kernel decisions and depends on the kernel only; docs/kani-lane.md cites ledger entries (e.g. 'ledger 0005', 'ledger/kani/') as records over the shipped kernel.
edge_citations.ae_kani_engine: Lane isolation: the Kani harness crate depends on the engine only. docs/kani-lane.md: 'the harnesses moved to a new workspace member crates/catherine-kani that depends only on it — cargo kani -p catherine-kani compiles the execution core, the harnesses, and nothing else'.

equations.rationale: the paired actual dependency edge targets the crate the policy allows
the paired actual dependency edge starts at the crate the policy allows
